title: 10% of visitors playing 5 or more AI-built/vibe coded games on Playground Arcade
author: mr_pr
selftext:
A little update on [Playground Arcade](https://playgroundarcade.com/), which I’m getting predictably, overly obsessed with. I built it to help people discover new games - I kept losing them as soon as I saw them on here/X!

There are now more than 2,200 AI-assisted games on the site. But I'm not just interested in how many games the site lists. It's about whether people are actually discovering them.

So far, Playground has recorded 3,630 game opens across 678 different games.

Among the recorded browsers that opened at least one game:

* **44% opened two or more different games**
* **24% opened three or more**
* **10% opened five or more**

That includes phones and tablets. These are clicks through to games, so they don’t tell me how long somebody played - but seeing people try several different games is encouraging.

Following feedback from creators, I’ve also added three related recommendations at the bottom of each game’s details, below the reviews. Hopefully, finding one game you like becomes a way to discover another creator’s work.

That sits alongside genre and device filters, short gameplay previews where I've been able to find them, play counts, ratings, written reviews, the option to save games to your list and personalised suggestions (in the 'Your Playground' section).

The site's free, doesn’t require an account (though you can log in so you don't lose info across devices/if your cache refreshes), and creators can submit games for free. Listings credit creators and send players to the original games.

**If you’re building an AI-assisted browser game, share it below - I’d love to take a look.** And what would help you find games you actually want to play?

[playgroundarcade.com](https://playgroundarcade.com/)
